title: Magnifying glass with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Handle -->
  <rect x='58' y='62' width='14' height='38' rx='7' fill='#8B5A2B' transform='rotate(-45 65 81)'/>
  <rect x='61' y='65' width='6' height='30' rx='3' fill='#C68642' transform='rotate(-45 65 81)'/>

  <!-- Lens rim outer -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='40' r='28' fill='#D4AF37'/>
  <!-- Lens rim inner (lighter edge) -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='40' r='24' fill='#F5E6A8'/>

  <!-- Glass -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='40' r='21' fill='#9BD7F0'/>
  <!-- Glass shine -->
  <circle cx='35' cy='32' r='6' fill='#D6F4FF'/>
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='30' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#D6F4FF'/>

  <!-- Face: eyes -->
  <circle cx='34' cy='38' r='3.5' fill='#1A3A4A'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='38' r='3.5' fill='#1A3A4A'/>
  <!-- Eye sparkles -->
  <circle cx='35' cy='37' r='1.2' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='51' cy='37' r='1.2' fill='#FFFFFF'/>

  <!-- Smiling mouth -->
  <path d='M32 47 Q42 56 52 47' stroke='#1A3A4A' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- Cheeks -->
  <circle cx='28' cy='46' r='3' fill='#FFA0B0' opacity='0.6'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='46' r='3' fill='#FFA0B0' opacity='0.6'/>
</svg>
